name: PM-KISAN
description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families. Check current status and exclusions on the official portal.
benefits: Direct income support in instalments; current amount and payment status should be confirmed on the portal.
eligibility: Landholding farmer families, subject to scheme rules and exclusions. The portal provides a Know Your Status service.
application_steps: Use New Farmer Registration or check status.
Follow the portal's current instructions and state verification process.
verification_status: Official portal linked; confirm current rules and eligibility there.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Government-funded health assurance scheme providing eligible families access to hospital care through empanelled providers.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospital care at empanelled hospitals, subject to scheme rules and package limits.
eligibility: Eligibility is based on government beneficiary databases and applicable state extensions; verify using the official beneficiary service.
documents: Beneficiary identification / Aadhaar or other accepted ID
Ration card or family ID where applicable
application_steps: Check beneficiary status using the official PM-JAY/NHA service.
Contact an Ayushman Mitra at an empanelled hospital for assistance.
verification_status: General description; beneficiary status and state rules require official verification.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: A government portal for discovery and application to scholarships offered by central ministries, states and other agencies.
benefits: Scholarship benefits vary by individual scheme and academic year.
eligibility: Criteria vary by scholarship, course, institution, income and category. Read the selected scheme guidelines.
application_steps: Review current schemes and eligibility guidelines.
Register, complete the application and track verification.
verification_status: Scheme-specific information must be checked on the current portal.

name: Karnataka SSP Scholarship
description: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal provides access to multiple department scholarship services. Availability and criteria depend on the scheme and academic year.
benefits: Benefits vary by department and scholarship; see current SSP notices.
eligibility: Varies by department, course, category, income and academic year. Confirm on the official portal.
documents: Caste and income certificates where applicable
application_steps: Select the relevant department/service and academic year.
Follow current application and institution verification instructions.
verification_status: Current services, URLs and criteria require portal verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Supports eligible adult women from poor households to obtain an LPG connection under current PMUY rules.
benefits: Eligible applicants may receive a deposit-free LPG connection and associated support as described in current guidelines.
eligibility: Applicant is a woman aged 18 or older.
No other LPG connection in the household.
Poor household criteria and prescribed declaration apply.
documents: Address proof if current address differs
Adult family members' Aadhaar as applicable
application_steps: Review the current PMUY eligibility and forms.
Apply through an LPG distributor or the official online process.
verification_status: Eligibility and documents summarized from official PMUY page; check current guidance.

name: MGNREGA
description: Rights-based rural employment programme. Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work may request work under the Act.
benefits: Wage employment subject to the Act, demand, local processes and applicable state wage rates.
eligibility: Adult members of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work; job card and local registration processes apply.
documents: Photographs as requested by Gram Panchayat
application_steps: Contact the Gram Panchayat to register the rural household and request a job card.
Submit a demand for work through the local process.
Check local notices and official MGNREGA records.
verification_status: General overview; local registration, wages and procedures require official verification.
